column5: GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `descriptor_results.rs` (4)** | 33. `DR:187-191` `Empty` origins are dropped from a slot's source list; `[Empty, Captured(x)]` resolves to `x`.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `descriptor_results.rs` (4)** | 34. `DR:1123` any `None` from `adapt` makes the whole graph `None`; callers that treat `None` as "no descriptor info" were not read.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 35. `UV:357` activation replay drops every unlisted operation; when the function has no activation-claim operations, unlisted structural-result operations are dropped too.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 36. `UV:883` the retained-ownership check returns `Ok` when `ownership_frontier_facts` is empty; whether another phase requires facts is open.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 37. `UV:2057-2063`, `UV:2089-2099` `EstablishCase` on a non-`Sum` type and `EstablishRecord` on a non-`Record` type `continue` past the range-authority check.
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 38. `UV:2067`, `UV:2100` `zip` of declared fields with initializers truncates.
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 39. `UV:2235-2237` `validate_range_fact` returns `Ok` when the kernel returns no requirement.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 40. `UV:2637`, `UV:2641` provenance: anything is accepted for jump, conditional and case nodes; extra trailing provenance is accepted for the rest.
